recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not re-add observation-deviceCode to core source; future changes to the extension's status, description, or binding should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and checked against FHIR-44332, FHIR-43391, and FHIR-46838.
issue_request: FHIR-17793 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It rejected changing Observation.device into a choice because Observation.device identifies a device instance, and instead requested a core extension like observation-specimenCode that can carry a CodeableConcept device kind when it is not already implicit in Observation.code, using the example binding from Device.type.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git commit dfe20c1, but that commit only corrected an Observation.focusCode link in source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml. Historical core source nevertheless contained source/observation/structuredefinition-extension-observation-deviceCode.xml and listed StructureDefinition/observation-deviceCode in the Observation core implementation guide, with CodeableConcept value[x] and an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-type. Commit dd468d4f17 later removed Observation extension definitions, including observation-deviceCode, from current core source.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml keeps Observation.device as Reference(Device|DeviceMetric), matching the resolution's device-instance semantics. The authoritative extension definition is now in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-deviceCode.xml, where it is active, Trial Use, scoped to Observation, has CodeableConcept value[x], and binds to ValueSet/device-type. Later FHIR-extensions decisions FHIR-44332, FHIR-43391, and FHIR-46838 debated deprecation/removal and ultimately restored active/trial-use status with a note about alternate Observation.device/Device.type representation.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The published empty commit records that the remaining authoritative artifact belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack, while the current FHIR core Observation.device definition remains correct.
